purpose: Staged computational data path for missing oldlevel/newlevel Hecke data.

true_newlevel_target.recommended_first_test: after oldlevel cleanup: det(T_5-a_5(E)) mod 3863 on the true new_subspace
true_newlevel_target.risk: high; split by Atkin-Lehner signs before a full determinant if possible

stages.name: Do not use LMFDB total traces as orbit evidence
stages.reason: The missing levels have only mf_newspaces rows. Total traces do not exclude individual orbit factors unless a one-orbit decomposition is known.

stages.name: Restlevel determinant filter
stages.test: Compute det(T_p-a_p(E)) mod 3863 on the newspace, starting with p=5.
stages.success_condition: nonzero determinant kills the level for that Reyssat orientation
stages.continuation: only if determinant is zero, compute the kernel and add p=7,11,13

stages.name: Kernel cascade
stages.test: Intersect kernels of T_p-a_p(E) modulo 3863 for p=5,7,11,13.
stages.success_condition: zero kernel kills the level; nonzero kernel is a real residual candidate

stages.name: Orbit/field recovery only after a kernel survivor
stages.test: Compute factor data, minimal polynomials, or q-adic field primes only on surviving subspace.
stages.reason: Full charpoly/order data are too expensive before the determinant/kernelfilter.

stages.name: True newlevel after restlevels
stages.test: Run the same determinant/kernelfilter on the 4752-dimensional new_subspace.
stages.guardrail: Avoid full S2 dimension 42209; use new_subspace and Atkin-Lehner splitting if Sage exposes it.

stages.name: FOG-FC evidence, not proof
stages.test: If q=3863 is killed or localized, repeat for several external primes and small T to estimate index support.
stages.guardrail: This remains data support for FOG-FC, not a proof of the asymptotic theorem.

interpretation: The next computational investment should be a mod-q determinant/kernel cascade on the three missing oldlevels, not a full level-240672 modular-symbol build. Only surviving kernels justify expensive orbit/Hecke-field recovery.
